page.title: Creative Strategy Consulting: What to Decide First
page.description: Learn the first decisions to make when hiring creative strategy consulting, including scope, team structure, tools, and approval workflows.
page.h1: What should you decide first about creative strategy consulting?
page.definition: Creative strategy consulting is an advisory engagement that assesses brand positioning, audience insight, and channel mix to produce a prioritised roadmap, tool selection, and governance model for content, campaigns, and creative operations.
page.quick_answer: Define the business outcome you want the creative function to drive, then decide whether you need a diagnostic assessment, a build-and-handoff playbook, or an embedded team to run daily operations.

sections.h2: What business outcome should the creative strategy serve?

blocks.p: Start with the measurable result the creative work must influence, such as pipeline contribution, community growth, or brand awareness lift.

ul: Revenue-attached campaigns that need creative briefs, production workflows, and performance reporting
Owned-audience building through events, newsletters, and community programmes
Brand repositioning that requires message architecture, visual system, and rollout governance
Creative operations maturity to reduce cycle time, revision rounds, and capacity waste

sections.h2: What team structure and roles do you need in-house versus outsourced?

blocks.p: Map the five core creative ops roles to your headcount and decide which stay internal and which move to a partner.

ul: Creative director: owns brand voice approval and product decisions; keep in-house
Producer: manages intake, brief, production, review, approval, publishing, reporting; can be outsourced
Designer and editor: execute assets in Figma, Frame.io, Adobe suite; often outsourced for volume
Operations manager: runs work management in Asana, Monday.com, or Wrike; hybrid ownership works
Analyst: owns GA4, HubSpot reporting, cycle-time dashboards; keep in-house for strategic insight

sections.h2: Which tool categories must be agreed before the engagement starts?

blocks.p: Lock the platform stack so the consultant designs workflows that fit your licences and security policies.

ol: Work management: Asana, Monday.com, or Wrike for intake, briefs, and capacity planning
Asset review and storage: Frame.io for video, Bynder or Brandfolder for approved files
Design collaboration: Figma for design systems and stakeholder comments
Publishing and distribution: WordPress, Webflow, or HubSpot for web; HubSpot or Salesforce for CRM hand-off
Analytics and reporting: GA4 and HubSpot for funnel and engagement metrics

sections.h2: What approval gates and SLAs should the creative workflow include?

blocks.p: Define the seven-stage pipeline with one owner, one output, and one approval gate per stage to prevent bottlenecks.

ul: Intake: request form submitted, brief owner assigned
Brief: creative brief completed in Google Docs or Notion, approved by creative director
Production: designer or producer creates assets in Figma or Frame.io
Review: stakeholders comment, revision rounds capped at two
Approval: final sign-off recorded in work management tool
Publishing: assets pushed to CMS or scheduling tool, UTM parameters attached
Reporting: performance data pulled into dashboard within 48 hours of publish

faq.q: How long does a creative strategy engagement usually take?
faq.a: A diagnostic assessment runs two to four weeks. A playbook build takes six to eight weeks including tool configuration. Embedded creative ops is ongoing, scoped in 90-day cycles with monthly reviews.

faq.q: What deliverables should I expect from a creative strategy consultant?
faq.a: Expect a current-state audit, a prioritised use-case list, a recommended tool stack, a governance model with roles and SLAs, and a phased roadmap with owners and dates. Playbook engagements add working automations and documentation.

faq.q: Can the consultant work inside our existing tools instead of recommending new ones?
faq.a: Yes. The consultant maps workflows to your licensed platforms such as Asana, Figma, Frame.io, and HubSpot. New tool recommendations only happen if a gap blocks the agreed outcomes.

faq.q: How do we measure whether the creative strategy is working?
faq.a: Track cycle time from brief to publish, revision rounds per asset, on-time delivery rate, and capacity utilisation. Tie creative output to downstream metrics like campaign conversion, email subscriber growth, or event registration.

faq.q: What is the typical cost structure for creative strategy consulting?
faq.a: Diagnostic assessments use a day rate or fixed project fee. Playbook builds charge a fixed build fee plus a monthly support retainer. Embedded creative ops is scoped per engagement with no published price list.
